key_reasoning.reason: Four components across two subsystems: the shared SSO conversation sync processor (prepareSendList heal -> collapse -> persist -> cap pipeline, per-payloadId outcome marking, removal of lastSyncedMessageUuid from syncUpdates), a new pure payload-queue helper module (getPayloadId, isSendCandidate, healSyncedDuplicates, collapseSupersededPayloads), the shared conversation types/constants contract (new terminal 'superseded' status, MAX_CONVERSATION_PAYLOADS_PER_RUN), and the Claude ConversationsProcessor (dedupe-before-append over queued payloadIds). Base L; bumped to XL because the sync processor and status contract serve every agent's conversation queue (claude, codex, gemini, opencode, pi, copilot-cli), not only Claude.

No exact precedent for record-level collapse or on-read healing: the processor now rewrites persisted queue statuses before sending, and a record marked 'superseded' is never sent, so a wrong coverage key (conversationId|history_index|role) would silently drop conversation data. The per-run cap is deliberately exempt for deadline-bounded SessionEnd runs, and the Claude dedupe read is lock-free (racing hooks can still both append). Mitigated by reuse of the existing atomic JSONL rewrite and sync-pointer patterns and by two dedicated edge-case test suites; no security, auth or external-contract change.

Diffstat reports 7 files (865 insertions, 91 deletions) -> L band (7-10). Roughly 5 modified source files (syncProcessor.ts, types.ts, constants.ts, claude.conversations-processor.ts, plus payload-queue.ts if it pre-existed) and 2 new test files (syncProcessor-dedupe.test.ts, claude.conversations-processor-dedupe.test.ts), spanning src/providers/plugins/sso/session/processors/conversations and src/agents/plugins/claude. Most of the insertion volume is in the tests.
